name: agent-orchestration
description: Always-on dispatch/coordination discipline for AI sub-agents and background agents: verify worktree-isolation scope before trusting it in another repo, hand continuation dispatches concrete already-discovered specifics, post labeled partial syntheses from parallel agents, stop (don't route around) IAM/secret-adjacent classifier blocks, and grep a shared log for ordinal collisions immediately before writing.

source.title: Agent Orchestration Baseline
source.relationship: Distilled from sessions where a sub-agent's worktree isolation was assumed (wrongly) to cover a different repo, a continuation dispatch re-derived already-known specifics, parallel background agents withheld a time-sensitive answer until every branch finished, an IAM-adjacent write hit a safety-classifier block, and a shared append-only log had a stale next-ordinal collision between concurrent sessions.
